theme.nightHint: Low-light dark mode for reading at night

settings.imageSaveFailed: Could not save the media source setting

sync.title: Miniflux sync
sync.description: Manage the current connection and full local article history.
sync.timeZoneMinifluxHint: From Miniflux account settings; used for every date and time.
sync.timeZoneBrowserHint: Miniflux time zone unavailable; using the browser time zone for every date and time.
sync.intervalSaveFailed: Could not save the Miniflux sync frequency
sync.resetHint: Clear cached articles and sync progress for this connection while keeping the reading profile, preferences, and credentials.
sync.resetConfirm: Clear cached articles and sync progress for this Miniflux connection and repeat the initial load? The reading profile and credentials will be kept.
sync.resetDone: Sync data reset; repeating the initial load

webdav.title: WebDAV data sync
webdav.description: Upload this client's reading events in monthly files and combine events read from other ReadFlux clients.
webdav.neverSynced: Not synced yet. Credentials are stored in plain text in this browser; events are plain JSON on WebDAV.
webdav.disconnected: WebDAV disconnected; server data was kept
webdav.missingFields: Enter the WebDAV URL and client name

recommendation.title: Local recommendation profile
recommendation.description: This shows raw reading events from this browser and WebDAV mirrors, plus weights derived from them and Miniflux saved articles. Scores are still used only to order Today.
recommendation.exportHint: The export is a local unencrypted file with reading events, ranking exposures, derived weights, and titles and excerpts of related articles. It never contains Miniflux or WebDAV credentials.
recommendation.webDavSyncing: WebDAV is syncing. Export will be available when sync finishes.
recommendation.webDavLastSynced: WebDAV last synced: {{time}}. The export includes mirrored events from other clients.
recommendation.webDavNeverSynced: WebDAV has not synced yet. The export includes only this browser's events.
recommendation.webDavExportStale: The export uses the last successfully mirrored WebDAV data.
recommendation.sourceWeightsHint: Smoothed reading depth (with diminishing credit for saved articles) × position-adjusted Today open rate, relative to the average feed, with time decay
recommendation.sourceAffinityDetail: Depth {{engagement}}% over {{reads}} reads · {{opens}} opens / {{impressions}} impressions → open rate ×{{openRate}} average · {{stars}} saved (+{{starWeight}})
recommendation.positiveTermsHint: Only followed topics get weight: 2r / (1 + r), where r is reading depth × Today open rate of articles mentioning the topic, relative to the average article, with time decay
recommendation.editorHint: Scroll depth uses 0–1; separate keywords with commas.
recommendation.missingFields: Enter an article title and source
recommendation.orderByPublished: This list sorts by publication time, newest first. The score does not change its order.
recommendation.orderByChanged: This list sorts by update time, newest first. The score does not change its order.
recommendation.breakdownSourceDetail: “{{source}}” has ×{{affinity}} the average feed affinity, converted with 20 × r / (1 + r)
recommendation.breakdownSourceUnknown: No reading data for “{{source}}” yet, so it counts as an average feed (×1)
recommendation.breakdownSourceEmpty: No reading data yet, so every feed scores 0
recommendation.breakdownTermsNoneFollowed: No topics followed yet; follow the hashtags under the title
recommendation.breakdownTopicDetail: {{term}}: depth {{engagement}}% over {{reads}} reads · {{opens}} opens / {{impressions}} seen → ×{{affinity}} the average article
recommendation.breakdownTopicNoData: {{term}}: no reading data yet, so it weighs 1
recommendation.breakdownTermsFormula: {{max}} × (1 − e^(−Σ weight / {{scale}})). Each topic weighs 2r / (1 + r), where r is its reading depth × Today open rate relative to the average article.

connect.headline:
Turn Miniflux into
your personal intelligence reader.
connect.lead: Articles come from Miniflux. Reading behavior stays in this browser by default and can optionally sync between ReadFlux clients through your WebDAV.
connect.keyBoundary: ● The key only goes between this browser and Miniflux
connect.directFailed: The browser cannot connect directly. Check HTTPS, the URL, and whether the reverse proxy allows CORS and X-Auth-Token.

feed.syncingHint: Unread articles appear first, followed by saved and read articles.
feed.emptyHint: Choose another feed or show all articles.
feed.laterEmptyHint: Use the bookmark button on an article, or click a link in one and choose Read later, to keep it here.
feed.noUnread: The current list has no unread articles
feed.noSummary: This article does not have a summary yet.

reader.selectHint: Reading behavior starts shaping Today only after you open an article.

readLater.unsupported: Read later needs Miniflux 2.2.16 or later; this server runs {{version}}
readLater.feedUnavailable: Miniflux could not fetch {{url}}. Open ReadFlux from its published address and try again.
readLater.failed: Could not save the link for later
readLater.queueEnd: This is the last article in Read later.
readLater.saveAndFinish: Save and remove from Read later
readLater.savedAndRemoved: Saved and removed from Read later
readLater.nextStarred: It is no longer in Read later; find it in Saved.
readLater.nextRemoved: It is no longer in Read later, and Miniflux deletes it after its cleanup period.
readLater.tagFailed: Could not update Read later in this browser

meta.description: ReadFlux is a local-first RSS client that connects to Miniflux and learns reading preferences in the browser.

ai.errorNetwork: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check the base URL and your network, and that the provider accepts requests from a browser (CORS).
ai.errorAuth: The AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings → AI.
ai.errorStatus: The AI provider returned an error ({{status}}). {{detail}}
ai.errorProvider: The AI provider reported an error. {{detail}}
ai.errorRefusal: The AI provider declined to process this article.
ai.errorEmpty: The AI provider returned no text for this article.
ai.errorTruncated: The AI provider stopped before finishing, so the result was not saved. Try again or choose a model with a longer output limit.
ai.errorIncomplete: The AI provider skipped part of the article, so the translation was not saved. Try again.
ai.providerDescription: Used only when you click Summarize or Translate on an article. Your browser calls the provider directly.
ai.modelHint: Type a model name, or load the list from the base URL.
ai.modelsAvailable_one: {{count}} model available. Pick from the suggestions or type a name.
ai.modelsAvailable_other: {{count}} models available. Pick from the suggestions or type a name.
ai.modelsEmpty: The provider returned no models. Type the model name instead.
ai.modelsUnavailable: This endpoint doesn't list models. Type the model name instead.
ai.effortHintAnthropic: Sent as output_config.effort to Claude 5 models. Lower effort is faster and cheaper.
ai.effortHintOpenAI: Sent as reasoning_effort. Only reasoning models accept it; keep the provider default for other models.
ai.baseURLHintOpenAI: Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, such as OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama, or LM Studio. Local servers must allow this site's origin.
ai.baseURLHintAnthropic: Calls the Anthropic Messages API directly from the browser.
ai.apiKeyHint: Stored unencrypted in this browser's localStorage and sent only to this provider.
ai.missingFields: Enter a base URL and model, plus an API key for Anthropic
ai.disconnectConfirm: Remove the AI provider settings and all saved summaries and translations from this browser?
ai.translationDescription: The language used by the Translate button and the Summary panel.
ai.targetLanguageHint: Summaries are written in this language too.
ai.savedDescription: Summaries and translations are kept in this browser, so reopening one costs nothing. Updated articles and language changes generate new results. {{modifier}}+click a button to regenerate.
ai.clearResultsConfirm: Delete all saved summaries and translations from this browser?
ai.privacyContent: When you click Summarize or Translate, that article's title and text are sent to {{host}}.
ai.privacyKey: Your API key is stored unencrypted in this browser and sent only to that provider.
ai.privacyNever: Reading events, recommendation data, and Miniflux credentials are never sent. AI settings are not part of the recommendation export.
